name: ACBM TECH
old_description: Shop for cash registers, commercial juicers, deli meat slicers, conveyor toasters, and more, all backed by our exceptional repair and maintenance services located in New York City.
about:
ACBM TECH operates a service shop and showroom at 184 Bowery in New York City's Lower East Side. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The business distributes and services a wide range of restaurant and retail equipment. Its product lineup includes SAM4s and HK Systems cash registers, OKPOS and Clover POS terminals, KIOSK systems, commercial juicers from brands such as Nutrifaster, Santos, Ceado, and Zumex, deli meat slicers, conveyor toasters, blenders, label-printing scales, Gardall safes, and time clocks. ACBM TECH also supplies service and delivery robots, digital signage, TV menu boards, and replacement parts for all supported equipment. The shop provides on-site repair and programming for cash registers, scales, juicers, blenders, conveyor toasters, and meat slicers, along with POS installation, merchant-account setup, and website design for hospitality clients.

Customers are primarily independent restaurants, cafes, delis, and other food-service or retail operators in the New York City area who need both equipment procurement and ongoing technical support.

ACBM TECH emphasizes that its inspection fee is waived when a repair proceeds, that all repairs carry a warranty period, and that its team aims to provide hassle-free installation and competitive merchant-service rates to minimize downtime for clients.
